resources.name: M-Lab NDT (Network Diagnostic Tool)
quotes: We emulate dynamic network conditions using thetcp-info stats dataset from the Measurement Lab’s Network Diagnostic Test (NDT), a public dataset containing speed tests taken by real users across the world [2].
references: [1] 2022. The M-Lab TCP INFO Data Set. https://measurementlab.net/tests/tcp-info
resources.used_in_paper_reasoning: The authors used the tcp-info stats dataset from M-Lab NDT to emulate dynamic network conditions for their in-lab data collection, as described in Section 4.2.
